pr.title: Evaluate a bounded coupled-mean response with an exact reflected kernel
pr.body:
Constructs and evaluates one continuous approximation to the retained coupled five-mean coefficient response. The complete conditional X-error bound is below 1.6090323e28, meeting the 1e29 target at the declared mesh limit 256. The insufficient bounds at 64 and 128 remain recorded. The approximation includes full mean couplings, reflected bulk feedback and shell lift; its remaining Robin defect is covered by the complete error identity.

The initial source run succeeded in both Python modes with byte-identical numerical data. Independent exact polygon/line integration reproduces every stored five-component feedback value and first derivative. The 21-file source capsule, ZIP, exact data, derivation and independent audits are now frozen; the final head must pass archive authentication, complete native regeneration and golden-byte comparison before merge.

All earlier scientific capsules and papers are preserved. The README and English/Spanish site updates are complete additive insertions; the companion shared-site PR modifies only HDBLAST. Full angular matching, an intrinsic observable sign, an exact nonlinear family and the proposed physical origin remain open. No new Zenodo version or journal submission.

pr.title: Publish the bounded coupled-mean HDBLAST checkpoint
pr.body:
Adds one dated HDBLAST result block for the verified bounded coupled-mean response pilot. The conditional C1 error is below 1.6090323e28, meeting the declared 1e29 target at the fixed 256 mesh limit. Coarser failed bounds and all frozen data are preserved in the companion research PR.

Only projects/hdblast/index.html changes. Removing the complete inserted block recovers the exact previous file; every other project remains unchanged. Full angular second-order matching, an invariant observable sign, a nonlinear family and a physical origin remain unestablished. Publication verification is pending the final source replay and Pages deployment. No new Zenodo version or journal submission is made.

All earlier scientific capsules and papers are preserved. The README and English/Spanish site updates are complete additive insertions; the companion shared-site PR modifies only HDBLAST. Full angular matching, an intrinsic observable sign, an exact nonlinear family and the proposed physical origin remain open. No new Zenodo version or journal submission.

Only projects/hdblast/index.html changes. Removing the complete inserted block recovers the exact previous file; every other project remains unchanged. json.title: Publish the bounded coupled-mean HDBLAST checkpoint
json.body:
Adds one dated HDBLAST result block for the verified bounded coupled-mean response pilot. The conditional C1 error is below 1.6090323e28, meeting the declared 1e29 target at the fixed 256 mesh limit. Coarser failed bounds and all frozen data are preserved in the companion research PR.

Only projects/hdblast/index.html changes. Removing the complete inserted block recovers the exact previous file; every other project remains unchanged. Full angular second-order matching, an invariant observable sign, a nonlinear family and a physical origin remain unestablished. Publication verification is pending the final source replay and Pages deployment. No new Zenodo version or journal submission is made.

Research: https://github.com/maldonado-research/HDblast/pull/84

The complete conditional X-error bound is below 1.6090323e28, meeting the 1e29 target at the declared mesh limit 256. The insufficient bounds at 64 and 128 remain recorded. The approximation includes full mean couplings, reflected bulk feedback and shell lift; its remaining Robin defect is covered by the complete error identity.

The initial source run succeeded in both Python modes with byte-identical numerical data. Independent exact polygon/line integration reproduces every stored five-component feedback value and first derivative. The 21-file source capsule, ZIP, exact data, derivation and independent audits are now frozen; the final head must pass archive authentication, complete native regeneration and golden-byte comparison before merge.

All earlier scientific capsules and papers are preserved. The README and English/Spanish site updates are complete additive insertions; the companion shared-site PR modifies only HDBLAST. Full angular matching, an intrinsic observable sign, an exact nonlinear family and the proposed physical origin remain open. No new Zenodo version or journal submission.

json.title: Evaluate a bounded coupled-mean response with an exact reflected kernel
json.body:
Constructs and evaluates one continuous approximation to the retained coupled five-mean coefficient response. The complete conditional X-error bound is below 1.6090323e28, meeting the 1e29 target at the declared mesh limit 256. The insufficient bounds at 64 and 128 remain recorded. The approximation includes full mean couplings, reflected bulk feedback and shell lift; its remaining Robin defect is covered by the complete error identity.

The initial source run succeeded in both Python modes with byte-identical numerical data. Independent exact polygon/line integration reproduces every stored five-component feedback value and first derivative. The 21-file source capsule, ZIP, exact data, derivation and independent audits are now frozen; the final head must pass archive authentication, complete native regeneration and golden-byte comparison before merge.

All earlier scientific capsules and papers are preserved. The README and English/Spanish site updates are complete additive insertions; the companion shared-site PR modifies only HDBLAST. Full angular matching, an intrinsic observable sign, an exact nonlinear family and the proposed physical origin remain open. No new Zenodo version or journal submission.

json.title: Publish the bounded coupled-mean HDBLAST checkpoint
json.body:
Adds one dated HDBLAST result block for the verified bounded coupled-mean response pilot. The conditional C1 error is below 1.6090323e28, meeting the declared 1e29 target at the fixed 256 mesh limit. Coarser failed bounds and all frozen data are preserved in the companion research PR.

Only projects/hdblast/index.html changes. Removing the complete inserted block recovers the exact previous file; every other project remains unchanged. Full angular second-order matching, an invariant observable sign, a nonlinear family and a physical origin remain unestablished. Publication verification is pending the final source replay and Pages deployment. No new Zenodo version or journal submission is made.

Research: https://github.com/maldonado-research/HDblast/pull/84

Only projects/hdblast/index.html changes. Removing the complete inserted block recovers the exact previous file; every other project remains unchanged. Full angular second-order matching, an invariant observable sign, a nonlinear family and a physical origin remain unestablished. Publication verification is pending the final source replay and Pages deployment. No new Zenodo version or journal submission is made.
